THE FAMILY COOKBOOK

Introduction
This little book collects the recipes our family has cooked for years. Enjoy them and make them your own.

Banana Bread
A family favorite for busy weeknights.
Serves 4
Ingredients
3 ripe bananas
1/3 cup melted butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 1/2 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
Directions
Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Mash the bananas and stir in the butter, sugar and egg.
Fold in the flour and baking soda, pour into the pan and bake for 60
minutes.

Chicken Noodle Soup
Prep time: 15 min   Cook time: 30 min
• 2 chicken breasts
• 8 cups chicken broth
• 2 carrots, sliced
• 2 celery stalks, sliced
• 2 cups egg noodles
• salt and pepper to taste
1. Simmer the chicken in the broth for 20 minutes, then shred it.
2. Add the carrots and celery and cook for 10 minutes until tender.
3. Stir in the noodles, cook 8 minutes, and season to taste.

Greek Salad
Serves 6
Ingredients
2 tomatoes, chopped
1 cucumber, sliced
1/2 red onion
1/2 cup feta cheese
1/4 cup olives
2 tbsp olive oil
Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and olives in a large bowl.
Top with feta, drizzle with olive oil and toss gently before serving.
Notes
Keeps well in the fridge for 3 days.

Beef Tacos
A family favorite for busy weeknights.
1 lb ground beef
1 packet taco seasoning
8 tortillas
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 cup shredded cheese
1. Brown the beef in a skillet over medium heat and drain the fat.
2. Stir in the seasoning with a splash of water and simmer for 5
minutes.
3. Fill the tortillas with beef, lettuce and cheese and serve right
away.

Fluffy Pancakes
Serves 4
Ingredients
• 1 cup flour
• 2 tbsp sugar
• 2 tsp baking powder
• 1 cup milk
• 1 egg
• 2 tbsp melted butter
Whisk the dry ingredients together in a bowl.
Whisk in the milk, egg and butter until just combined.
Cook ladlefuls on a hot greased griddle until bubbles form, then flip.

Chocolate Chip Cookies
Prep time: 15 min   Cook time: 30 min
2 1/4 cups flour
1 cup butter, softened
3/4 cup brown sugar
2 eggs
2 cups chocolate chips
1 tsp vanilla
Instructions
1. Cream the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and
vanilla.
2. Mix in the flour and fold in the chocolate chips.
3. Drop spoonfuls on a baking sheet and bake at 375°F for 10 minutes.

Garlic Mashed Potatoes
A family favorite for busy weeknights.
Serves 6
Ingredients
3 lbs potatoes, peeled
4 cloves garlic
1/2 cup butter
1 cup milk
salt to taste
Boil the potatoes and garlic in salted water until very tender, about
20 minutes.
Drain well and mash with the butter and warm milk until smooth.

Classic Guacamole
• 3 avocados
• 1 lime, juiced
• 1/2 onion, diced
• 2 tbsp cilantro
• 1 jalapeno, minced
• salt to taste
1. Mash the avocados with the lime juice in a bowl.
2. Stir in the onion, cilantro and jalapeno and season with salt.

Strawberry Jam
Serves 4
Ingredients
2 lbs strawberries, hulled
3 cups sugar
1/4 cup lemon juice
Crush the strawberries in a heavy pot and stir in the sugar and lemon
juice.
Bring to a rolling boil and cook, stirring often, until thickened,
about 15 minutes.
Ladle into clean jars and seal.
Notes
Keeps well in the fridge for 3 days.

Fresh Lemonade
A family favorite for busy weeknights.
Prep time: 15 min   Cook time: 30 min
1 cup lemon juice
1 cup sugar
6 cups cold water
ice
1. Stir the sugar into one cup of hot water until it dissolves.
2. Mix with the lemon juice and the rest of the cold water and serve
over ice.

Beef Stew
Serves 6
Ingredients
• 2 lbs beef chuck, cubed
• 3 tbsp flour
• 4 cups beef broth
• 4 potatoes, cubed
• 3 carrots, chopped
• 1 onion, chopped
Method
Toss the beef in flour and brown it in batches in a large pot.
Add the broth and onion, cover and simmer for 90 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots and cook 30 minutes more until tender.

Caesar Salad
1 head romaine lettuce
1/2 cup croutons
1/3 cup parmesan cheese
1/2 cup caesar dressing
1. Chop the romaine and place it in a large bowl.
2. Add the dressing, croutons and parmesan and toss to coat.

Spaghetti Bolognese
A family favorite for busy weeknights.
Serves 4
Ingredients
1 lb spaghetti
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 tsp oregano
Cook the onion and garlic in oil until soft, then brown the beef.
Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 30 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and toss with the sauce.

Apple Pie
Prep time: 15 min   Cook time: 30 min
• 2 pie crusts
• 6 apples, sliced
• 3/4 cup sugar
• 2 tbsp flour
• 1 tsp cinnamon
• 2 tbsp butter
1. Toss the apples with the sugar, flour and cinnamon.
2. Pour into the bottom crust, dot with butter and cover with the top
crust.
3. Bake at 425°F for 45 minutes until golden and bubbling.

Roasted Vegetables
Serves 6
Ingredients
2 zucchini, chopped
1 red pepper, chopped
1 red onion, chopped
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp salt
Toss the vegetables with the oil and salt on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes, stirring halfway, until browned.
Notes
Keeps well in the fridge for 3 days.

Deviled Eggs
A family favorite for busy weeknights.
6 hard boiled eggs
1/4 cup mayonnaise
1 tsp mustard
paprika for garnish
Directions
1. Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl.
2. Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise and mustard and spoon back into
the whites.
3. Sprinkle with paprika and chill until serving.

Homemade Pizza Dough
Serves 4
Ingredients
• 3 cups flour
• 1 packet yeast
• 1 cup warm water
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp salt
Dissolve the yeast in the warm water and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Mix in the flour, oil and salt and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour before shaping.

Vanilla Cupcakes
Prep time: 15 min   Cook time: 30 min
1 1/2 cups flour
1 cup sugar
1/2 cup butter
2 eggs
1/2 cup milk
2 tsp vanilla
1. Beat the butter and sugar, then add the eggs one at a time.
2. Mix in the flour, milk and vanilla until smooth.
3. Fill lined muffin cups two thirds full and bake at 350°F for 20
minutes.

Breakfast Burritos
A family favorite for busy weeknights.
Serves 6
Ingredients
6 eggs
4 large tortillas
1 cup cooked sausage
1 cup shredded cheese
1/2 cup salsa
Scramble the eggs in a buttered skillet until just set.
Divide the eggs, sausage, cheese and salsa among the tortillas and
roll up tightly.

Tomato Basil Soup
• 2 tbsp butter
• 1 onion, chopped
• 2 cans (28 oz) whole tomatoes
• 2 cups vegetable broth
• 1/2 cup heavy cream
• 1/4 cup fresh basil
1. Melt the butter and cook the onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
2. Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
3. Blend until smooth, then stir in the cream and basil.
